## Load Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load Massachusetts police stops dataset
massachusetts_data <- read_csv(
  "~/Desktop/Past Classes/stats310/data/ma_statewide_2020_04_01.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Inspect Structure

```{r}
glimpse(massachusetts_data)
```

## Data Overview

```{r}
nrow(massachusetts_data) # total stops
```

### Key Variables

```{r}
massachusetts_data %>%
  select(subject_race, subject_sex, search_conducted,
         contraband_found, arrest_made) %>%
  summary()
```

## Distribution of Stops by Race

```{r}
# Clean race labels
massachusetts_data <- massachusetts_data %>%
  mutate(
    subject_race = recode(
      subject_race,
      "Black or African American" = "Black",
      "Hispanic or Latino" = "Hispanic"
    )
  )

# Compute proportions
race_dist <- massachusetts_data %>%
  count(subject_race) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n))

ggplot(race_dist,
       aes(x = reorder(subject_race, percent), y = percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(percent, accuracy = 0.1)),
    hjust = -0.1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Stops by Race",
    x = "Race",
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Severity by Gender

```{r}
gender_severity <- massachusetts_data %>%
  group_by(subject_sex) %>%
  summarize(
    search_rate = mean(search_conducted == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    arrest_rate = mean(arrest_made == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gender_severity
```

### Plot

```{r}
gender_severity %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(search_rate, arrest_rate),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "rate"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = subject_sex, y = rate, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Stop Severity by Gender",
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Severity by Race

```{r}
# Clean race labels
massachusetts_data <- massachusetts_data %>%
  mutate(
    subject_race = recode(
      subject_race,
      "Black or African American" = "Black",
      "Hispanic or Latino" = "Hispanic"
    )
  )

# Compute severity rates
race_severity <- massachusetts_data %>%
  group_by(subject_race) %>%
  summarize(
    search_rate = mean(search_conducted == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    arrest_rate = mean(arrest_made == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Convert to long format
race_severity_long <- race_severity %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(search_rate, arrest_rate),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "rate"
  )

# Plot (flipped for readability)
ggplot(
  race_severity_long,
  aes(x = reorder(subject_race, rate), y = rate, fill = type)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Stop Severity by Race",
    x = "Race",
    y = "Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Confidence Interval for Differences in Gender

```{r}
# Remove missing gender
gender_clean <- massachusetts_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject_sex))

# Counts
male_count <- sum(gender_clean$subject_sex == "male")
female_count <- sum(gender_clean$subject_sex == "female")

total_male_female <- male_count + female_count

# Two-proportion confidence interval
prop.test(
  c(male_count, female_count),
  c(total_male_female, total_male_female),
  conf.level = 0.95,
  correct = FALSE
)
```

## Confidence Interval for Differences in Race

```{r}
# Remove missing race
race_clean <- massachusetts_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(subject_race))

# Counts
white_count <- sum(race_clean$subject_race == "white")
nonwhite_count <- sum(race_clean$subject_race != "white")

total_race <- white_count + nonwhite_count

# Two-proportion confidence interval
prop.test(
  c(white_count, nonwhite_count),
  c(total_race, total_race),
  conf.level = 0.95,
  correct = FALSE
)
```

## Search Rate and Arrest Rate Confidence Intervals

### Gender Confidence Intervals

```{r}
gender_ci <- massachusetts_data %>%
  group_by(subject_sex) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    search_success = sum(search_conducted == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    arrest_success = sum(arrest_made == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    search_ci = list(prop.test(search_success, n)$conf.int),
    arrest_ci = list(prop.test(arrest_success, n)$conf.int)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    search_low = sapply(search_ci, `[`, 1),
    search_high = sapply(search_ci, `[`, 2),
    arrest_low = sapply(arrest_ci, `[`, 1),
    arrest_high = sapply(arrest_ci, `[`, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(-search_ci, -arrest_ci)

gender_ci
```

### Race Confidence Intervals

```{r}
race_ci <- massachusetts_data %>%

  ) %>%

race_ci
```

## Logistic Model for Search Rate Based on Race and Gender

```{r}
model1 <- glm(
  search_conducted ~ subject_race + subject_sex,
  data = massachusetts_data,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model1)
```

### Model with Race and Gender Interaction

```{r}
model2 <- glm(
  search_conducted ~ subject_race * subject_sex,
  data = massachusetts_data,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model2)
```

## Escalation of Police Stops Confidence Intervals

```{r}
escalation_ci <- massachusetts_data %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    searched_success = sum(search_conducted == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    contraband_success = sum(contraband_found == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    arrested_success = sum(arrest_made == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

get_ci <- function(success, n) {
  prop.test(success, n)$conf.int
}

escalation_ci <- escalation_ci %>%
  mutate(
    search_rate = searched_success / n,
    contraband_rate = contraband_success / n,
    arrest_rate = arrested_success / n,
    search_ci = list(get_ci(searched_success, n)),
    contraband_ci = list(get_ci(contraband_success, n)),
    arrest_ci = list(get_ci(arrested_success, n))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    search_low = sapply(search_ci, `[`, 1),
    search_high = sapply(search_ci, `[`, 2),
    contraband_low = sapply(contraband_ci, `[`, 1),
    contraband_high = sapply(contraband_ci, `[`, 2),
    arrest_low = sapply(arrest_ci, `[`, 1),
    arrest_high = sapply(arrest_ci, `[`, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(-search_ci, -contraband_ci, -arrest_ci)

escalation_ci
```

# Extended Analysis: Bias Index

```{r}
# Create a bias index to compare how often groups are searched
# relative to how often contraband is actually found

bias_index <- massachusetts_data %>%
  # Remove missing race and gender values
  filter(!is.na(subject_race), !is.na(subject_sex)) %>%

  # Group data by race and gender
  group_by(subject_race, subject_sex) %>%

  # Compute totals and rates for each demographic group
  summarise(
    # Total number of stops
    total_stops = n(),

    # Number of searches conducted
    searches = sum(search_conducted == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Number of searches where contraband was found
    contraband_found_total = sum(contraband_found == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Search rate: proportion of all stops that resulted in a search
    search_rate = searches / total_stops,

    # Hit rate: proportion of searches that resulted in contraband being found
    hit_rate = contraband_found_total / searches,

    # Bias index: search rate divided by search success
    # Higher values suggest more searches relative to contraband findings
    bias_index = search_rate / hit_rate,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Remove groups with invalid calculations
  filter(
    searches > 0,
    !is.na(hit_rate),
    !is.infinite(bias_index)
  )

# Display table
bias_index
```

## Create Visualization

```{r}
ggplot(
  bias_index,
  aes(
    x = subject_race,
    y = bias_index,
    fill = subject_sex
  )
) +
  # Create grouped bar chart
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +

  # Flip coordinates for readability
  coord_flip() +

  # Add labels and title
  labs(
    title = "Bias Index by Race and Gender",
    subtitle = "Search Rate Divided by Contraband Hit Rate",
    x = "Race",
    y = "Bias Index",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +

  # Clean theme
  theme_minimal()
```
